    Why Choose Cashify?

    Download the AppSell your old phone | Buy top-quality refurbished phones | Get your phone repaired

    Sell Old Phone And Get Instant Cash

    Upgrading your smartphone or clearing out unused gadgets? With Cashify, you can sell old mobile phones in a quick, safe, and completely hassle-free way. Instead of letting your device collect dust, convert it into instant cash in just a few steps. Cashify is trusted by millions across India for offering fair prices, doorstep convenience, and secure transactions.

    Check Your Phone’s Value In Seconds

    Getting started is easy. Simply choose your phone’s brand and model, answer a few questions about its condition, and receive an instant resale price. Cashify uses real-time market data to ensure accurate and competitive pricing, so you always get the best possible value when you sell old phone, without bargaining or hidden deductions.

    Sell Old Phone From Home With Free Doorstep Pickup

    No store visits. No courier hassles. Once you confirm the price, book a free doorstep pickup at a time that suits you. A trained Cashify executive will visit your location, verify the device, and complete the pickup smoothly. The entire experience to sell old mobile phone is designed to save your time and effort.

    Get Paid Instantly, Without Delays

    Why wait for your money? With Cashify, you receive instant payment as soon as your phone is picked up. Choose from secure payment options such as UPI, bank transfer, or cash. The process is fast, reliable, and transparent, so you’re always in control.

    Phones Accepted In All Conditions

    Cashify makes it easy to sell old phone in any condition. Whether your device is brand new, lightly used, has scratches, a broken screen, battery issues, or is not working at all, you can still sell it. Cashify accepts phones from all major brands and ensures you get the maximum resale value regardless of condition.

    Your Privacy Comes First

    Your data security is our responsibility. Cashify follows strict privacy standards and offers certified data wiping to permanently erase all personal information from your device. You can sell old mobile phone confidently, knowing your data is fully protected.

    Sell Smart. Sell Sustainably.

    Selling your old phone on Cashify isn’t just convenient, it’s also environmentally responsible. Cashify encourages the reuse and recycling of electronic devices, helping reduce e-waste and support a greener future.

    Why Millions Trust Cashify

    1. Quick and accurate price evaluation

    2. Free doorstep pickup across cities

    3. Instant and secure payments

    4. Guaranteed data safety

    5. Supports all brands and phone conditions

    Whether you’re upgrading to a new phone or simply decluttering your space, Cashify offers the smartest way to sell old phone online.

    How do I sell my old phone on Cashify?

    Selling your phone on Cashify is simple. Select your phone’s brand and model, check its price by answering a few condition-related questions, confirm the quote, and book a free doorstep pickup. Your phone will be picked up and payment will be made instantly.

    Can I sell old phone that was bought internationally (not Indian variant)?

    Usually yes, but it depends. Some international variants might not be supported due to compatibility or valuation issues. You may not get as accurate a quote automatically, so it's best to contact Cashify support or select “Other” when choosing the model.

    Can I sell a phone that’s still under EMI or loan? Will Cashify check for this?

    No, selling a phone that’s still under EMI is not recommended unless it's fully paid off. While Cashify might not always verify EMI status during pickup, selling underfinanced phones is legally risky. It could lead to rejection or recovery action.

    Why should I use Cashify to sell my phone?

    Cashify makes it quick, easy, and profitable to sell old phone. With AI-powered pricing, instant payment, and free pickup, Cashify is a great choice.

    How does Cashify decide how much to pay to sell mobile phones online?

    Cashify uses AI technology to check the market price and assess your phone’s condition. It considers things like scratches, battery life, and damage to give you the best price.

    Can I sell any phone model on Cashify?

    Yes! Cashify accepts almost all phones. Cashify will help you find a buyer whether your phone is old or new.

    Is it safe to sell my phone with Cashify?

    Yes, Cashify is a safe and trusted platform. Unlike other buyers, Cashify offers a secure and easy process with no hidden fees or safety risks.

    Are there any hidden fees when I sell my phone?

    No, there are no hidden charges. The whole process is straightforward and easy.

    How do I know the price of my old phone?

    Just visit the website or app, enter your phone details (brand, model, condition), get an instant price. Accept the offer and schedule a free pickup. You’ll get paid once the phone is checked.

    What should I do if my sell old phone is not turning on?

    Even if your phone is off or not working, you can still sell it. Just mention the condition, and Cashify will give you a fair price.

    Can I sell my old phone if it does not power on?

    Yes, Cashify accepts non-working phones as well. However, you need to select the right condition when answering questions on the website when you sell used phone with us. You might get a lower price but we still offer a fair price for damaged phones.

    What documents do I need to sell my phone on Cashify?

    When selecting your device’s conditions, you will be asked about the bill and original documents. Even if you don't have it, you still can sell mobile phones online on Cashify.

    Is doorstep pickup really free?

    Yes, Cashify offers 100% free doorstep pickup. There are no hidden charges for pickup or inspection.

    Why should I sell my phone on Cashify instead of a local shop?

    Cashify offers better price transparency, free doorstep pickup, instant payments, and guaranteed data safety, making it safer and more convenient than local dealers.
